title: Particle / חלקיק
definition: A point-like excitation follows a worldline.

title: String / מיתר
definition: A one-dimensional object is labelled along $\sigma$.

title: Vibrational mode / אופן תנודה
definition: Allowed shapes form a discrete mode family.

title: Particle as a string state
definition: Different quantized excitations appear as different states.

title: String tension / מתיחות
definition: Tension sets the energy per unit length.

title: Worldline and worldsheet
definition: A moving string sweeps a two-dimensional worldsheet.

title: Embedding into spacetime
definition: Worldsheet coordinates map into target spacetime.

title: Splitting and joining
definition: String interactions are smooth splitting/joining worldsheets.

title: D-brane / ממברנת D
definition: Open-string endpoints can be fixed to a D-brane.

title: Compact dimension
definition: A compact direction closes on itself with radius $R$.

title: T-duality
definition: Momentum and winding exchange under radius inversion.

title: Closed-string gravity state
definition: A massless closed-string level contains a spin-2 sector.

title: Worldsheet supersymmetry
definition: Bosonic and fermionic worldsheet fields are paired.

title: Critical dimension
definition: Quantum consistency fixes model-dependent critical dimensions.

title: String coupling and dilaton
definition: The dilaton expectation value sets perturbative coupling.
